premises.text: Busy people need household help without spending time and mental energy coordinating multiple on-demand services
premises.evidence_span: all of that takes time and coordination and the mental energy. Dan doesn't want to give it

premises.text: Alfred is a service layer plus a real neighborhood person who visits weekly on set days and coordinates chores across on-demand and local verticals automatically
premises.evidence_span: Alfred is actually a service layer. It sits on top of other on-demand and local services

premises.text: Vetted neighborhood Alfreds are assigned via clustering/scheduling and group chores across neighbors for economies of scale
premises.evidence_span: each neighborhood has its own dedicated Alfreds, which visit once a week, every week on set days

premises.text: Users set automatic preferences and recurring tasks; Alfred selects providers and handles key access and unified in-app payment
premises.evidence_span: The magic of Alfred is you don't have to make requests. You set things to be automatic

premises.text: Building partnerships turn on neighborhoods overnight and make the model scalable
premises.evidence_span: we partner with buildings, which allows us to turn on neighborhoods overnight, making us scalable

premises.text: Service is offered at $99 per month for weekly visits
premises.evidence_span: For $99 a month, Dan can get his very own Alfred that visits once a week

value.text: Give busy people back their time through seamless personal household service
value.evidence_span: we are going to give you back the most precious resource you have, your time

secondary_value.text: Well-paid work for vetted community members helping neighbors
secondary_value.evidence_span: Alfreds are vetted members of your community who enjoy well-paid work that they are proud of helping their neighbors

causal_links.evidence_span: Alfred anticipates that Dan will need to press that on-demand button and works and acts in the background
they group chores, which gives us economies of scale that we can pass along to you
the luxury of personal service for the rest of us

notes: Traction metrics (retention, household counts) excluded. Automatic preferences, provider selection, key access, and payment folded into P4 as one commercial service surface. Singleton D2 justified as separately revisable ops/staffing module.
